explanation.headline: Magnesium sulfate is not on FDA's shortage list today; two hospital sites hold 18 to 28 days of supply and the labeled plant for one NDC shows only VAI inspections through 2025-06-26

sentences.text: FDA's current shortage list contains no entry for magnesium sulfate, only discontinued multi‑electrolyte products from Fresenius Kabi, Fresenius Medical Care, and Vantive.
Corvale East reports 336 units on hand at 12.2 units per day, giving 28 days of supply.
Corvale General reports 235 units on hand at 13.4 units per day, giving 18 days of supply.
The label for NDC 51662135203 identifies HF Acquisition Co LLC (DBA HealthFirst) as the registered plant with FEI 3014534.
FDA inspection records for that FEI show only Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI) classifications, the most recent ending 2025-06-26.
Because the links between the hospital NDCs and the inspected plant are weak, verify the actual manufacturer and lot‑level sourcing for each site's magnesium sulfate inventory.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Q-b5c72a.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%magnesium%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%magnesium%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-72d466.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('7d94995b-9e2a-0345-e053-2991aa0a62d0') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-6e482d.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%magnesium%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-813b91.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%magnesium%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-17d6ce.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%magnesium%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%inject%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-336bbe.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('hf acquisition dba healthfirst', 'hf acquisition') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%magnesium%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-57f6d2.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('51662135203')
